answer: Before any reward is paid, Admitted newsagent commission with newsagents federation certification steps in — a commission newsagents issue after round audits — and the island is that one proof covers exactly one name. The defence never needs to name the farm: the voyage is a toll collected before the reward, never after. The price of the hundredth clone is the same as the first: £30 in fees and handling for every proof, which is why the ridge turns red as the farm grows. The gate does not care who runs the farm, only how many names it brings.
